title: [LOGGED OUT] Mobile Store has no sideways scroll and a scrollable tab bar
reason: No page-level horizontal scroll; tab bar scrolls (Free wares first); free cards 2 per row. Mobile via Chrome mobileEmulation fallback (390x844, DPR 3, iPhone UA), not emulate_device.

steps.text: Open https://site.ludus-game.com/store/ in the browser on a phone screen (iPhone 14 size, 390x844) and wait until the page has finished loading.
steps.saw: Store page loaded at 390px wide with heading "LUDUS・Official Webshop"; cookie banner shown.

steps.text: If a "How we use cookies" banner is shown, click "Dismiss".
steps.saw: Cookie banner shown; clicked Dismiss, banner closed. "Add It to Home Screen" banner then visible at the bottom.

steps.text: If an "Add It to Home Screen" banner is shown at the bottom, click its X (close) button. Do not click "Claim" on that banner.
steps.saw: Banner shown; clicked its X ("Close pwa banner"), banner gone. Claim not clicked.

steps.text: Is the page free of horizontal scrolling (the page is not wider than the screen)?
steps.saw: document.documentElement.scrollWidth = 390, body.scrollWidth = 390, innerWidth = 390. Only carousel (swiper) slides extend past the edge and are clipped inside their slider.
Scrolled down 1400px; red "Store" ribbon heading (H2) at the top of the view with the tab bar below.

steps.text: Is the tab bar shown with "Free wares" as the first tab?
steps.saw: Tab bar shows Free wares (selected, yellow), Battle Passes, Licenses, Might Pass... cut at the right edge. It scrolls sideways (overflow-x auto, scrollWidth 1100 vs 354 visible) with 12 tabs: Free wares, Battle Passes, Licenses, Might Passes, Ludus Royal, Ethereal Crystals, Spells, Runes, Dice of Fortune, Gold, Emeralds, Gift to friends.

steps.text: Are the "Free emeralds" and "Free Gold" cards shown side by side, 2 per row?
steps.saw: Free emeralds card at x=27 and Free Gold card at x=203, both y=219, width 160 each: side by side in one row (2 per row). Claim buttons not clicked.
